sentences.en: We’re still in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我们还在爱尔兰。

sentences.en: We arrived in Dublin four days ago.
sentences.zh: 我们四天前到了都柏林。

sentences.en: My sister and I liked it a lot – it was great – we weren’t bored at all!
sentences.zh: 我和妹妹都很喜欢那里——特别棒——我们一点儿都不无聊！

sentences.en: Then yesterday, after lunch, Dad hired a car and we travelled to the west of Ireland – it didn’t take very long, just about two and a half hours, but that was a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 然后昨天午饭后，爸爸租了一辆车，我们开车去了爱尔兰西部——路不太远，只开了大概两个半小时，不过那段路有点无聊。

sentences.en: But, after two hours, Dad turned round to us and said: ‘We’ve got a surprise for you.
sentences.zh: 但开了两小时后，爸爸转过头对我们说：“我们给你们准备了一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Tonight our hotel is a castle! How exciting is that!’
sentences.zh: 今晚我们的酒店是一座城堡！多让人兴奋啊！”

sentences.en: A joke, right? Wrong!
sentences.zh: 开玩笑的吧？才不是！

sentences.en: We didn’t think he was serious, but he was!
sentences.zh: 我们原以为他不是认真的，结果他是认真的！

sentences.en: At the end of the journey, we stopped outside a real castle.
sentences.zh: 旅程结束的时候，我们把车停在了一座真正的城堡外面。

sentences.en: A nice lady welcomed us and started to show us around.
sentences.zh: 一位和蔼的女士迎接我们，开始带我们四处参观。

sentences.en: What an amazing place!
sentences.zh: 这地方太惊人了！

sentences.en: Can you believe that we walked up fifty stone steps to get to the living room?
sentences.zh: 你能相信吗，我们爬了五十级石阶才到客厅？

sentences.en: The castle is over 600 years old, but it had everything we needed.
sentences.zh: 这座城堡有 600 多年历史，但我们需要的东西它全都有。

sentences.en: There was a bedroom for our parents and we each had a bedroom, too.
sentences.zh: 有给我们父母的一间卧室，我们每人也各有一间。

sentences.en: But I didn’t sleep very well last night – I was so excited to be in a real castle!
sentences.zh: 但我昨晚睡得不太好——能住在真正的城堡里，我太兴奋了！

sentences.en: This morning we had breakfast and then we climbed up to the top of the castle.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我们吃了早饭，然后爬到了城堡顶上。

sentences.en: We were amazed at the beautiful countryside around us.
sentences.zh: 周围美丽的乡村景色让我们惊叹不已。

sentences.en: Then it started to rain and there was a fantastic rainbow – I love rainbows!
sentences.zh: 后来下起了雨，还出现了一道绚丽的彩虹——我爱彩虹！

sentences.en: The place was so great, we didn’t want to leave.
sentences.zh: 这地方太棒了，我们都不想走。

sentences.en: This afternoon we want to go to Limerick, so we’re packing our bags again!
sentences.zh: 今天下午我们想去利默里克，所以我们又在收拾行李了！

sentences.en: Can it be as good as a castle? Let’s see.
sentences.zh: 它能和城堡一样好吗？走着瞧吧。
